subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Types of reading and reading speeds; calculating words per minute / Timed reading practice and Time to Talk: ranking the tips
outcomes: Identify types of reading and their speeds
Calculate reading speed in words per minute
Practise timed reading and rank tips for new students

tf.s: We read different types of texts at different speeds.
tf.why: Yes, a contract and a magazine need different speeds.

tf.s: Close reading is below 100 words per minute.
tf.why: Correct, close reading is the slowest.

tf.s: Skimming is the slowest type of reading.
tf.why: Skimming is the fastest: above 400 wpm.

tf.s: Reading speed = total number of words ÷ time taken in minutes.
tf.why: Right, that gives words per minute.

tf.s: 300 words read in 2 minutes is a speed of 600 wpm.
Casual reading, like newspapers and magazines, is 250–400 wpm.
tf.why: Yes, informal reading is quite fast.

tf.s: You should answer the questions while you are doing the timed reading.
tf.why: Answering during reading distracts you; answer after.

tf.s: In timed reading, you should aim for about 75% accuracy.
tf.why: Correct, speed must come with understanding.

tf.s: Reading fast without understanding is the main aim.
tf.why: The aim is to read fast while still understanding.

tf.s: Recording your WPM helps you see if you are improving.
tf.why: Yes, you can compare with later readings.

boxes.q: What is the formula for reading speed?
boxes.why: Divide the words by the minutes.
Close reading is slow and careful.
Academic reading is in this range.

boxes.q: What accuracy should you aim for?
When do you answer the timed-reading questions?

boxes.why: You rank tips from most to least useful.

boxes.q: Why do university students need to read fast?
boxes.why: Essays, research and exams need lots of reading.

mcq.q: What type of reading do newspapers and magazines need?
Why must you answer the questions after reading, not during?
o: it makes reading slower on purpose
mcq.why: Focus on reading first, then answer.

mcq.q: Which list shows reading types from slowest to fastest?
Which is a way to improve reading speed?
A student reads 900 words in 2 minutes. What is her speed?
A student reads 180 words in 2 minutes. Which type of reading is this speed?
You need to read a contract carefully before signing. Which reading do you use?
mcq.why: Important details need slow, careful reading.

mcq.q: Why is speed without understanding not enough?
o: the aim is to read fast while still understanding
speed is the only thing that matters
mcq.why: You must understand what you read.

mcq.q: Why is it useful to record your WPM and score each time?
o: to compare later readings and see progress
to give it to a friend

mcq.q: Why do we read a contract and a magazine at different speeds?
o: they have different purposes and levels of detail
mcq.why: Your purpose decides your reading speed.
